description: Public mixed-filament gradients preserve configured ratios and independent object and volume run metadata.

mutants.description: Retaining layer zero in the per-object gradient run makes total_layers/current_idx include the adhesion layer, contrary to the public metadata contract that skips the first layer.
Retaining layer zero in per-volume run segmentation shifts each tagged volume run length and current index while leaving the public fixture valid.
Using the start ratio for both parsed endpoints is caught by the independent configured 0.8-to-0.2 metadata assertions in both per-part modes.
